name: Patrol boat
note: Attack class, 1967; Australia built twenty of these itself.

name: Destroyer (Hobart)
note: Bought from Defoe, Michigan; three of them.

name: Light carrier (Melbourne)

name: Battleship (Missouri)

name: Supercarrier (Constellation)
note: Two hundred and fifty thousand steel, and then an air wing, and then a fleet to protect it. This is why.
